extractionHint.zh-CN: 证词原话、互相矛盾的细节、推理过程与尚未验证的猜测。每条线索的核实状态由「案情板」维度记录，这里不重复状态。
extractionHint.en-US: Exact testimony, contradicting details, lines of reasoning, and untested theories. Each lead's verification status lives in the Case Board dimension; do not repeat it here.

extractionHint.zh-CN: 已获得或见识过的远古遗物、其鉴定结果、效果、风险与归属。
extractionHint.en-US: Ancient relics obtained or seen, their appraisals, effects, risks, and ownership.

extractionHint.zh-CN: 关于退潮时间、雾兽出没与安全/危险窗口的观察和传闻。深退潮阶段由「深退潮」维度记录，主角雾蚀由角色属性记录，这里不重复。
extractionHint.en-US: Observations and rumors about ebb timing, fog-beast sightings, and safe/danger windows. The deep-withdrawal stage lives in the Deep Withdrawal dimension and the hero's fog-rot in character attributes; do not repeat them.

extractionHint.zh-CN: 玩家对议会、公会、盐牙会、雾中教会作出的具体承诺与交易的来龙去脉：谁、为了什么、条件是什么。各方态度数值与许可/通缉/人情标记由「四方立场」维度记录。
extractionHint.en-US: The story behind promises and deals made to the Council, Guild, Salt Fangs, and Congregation: who, for what, and on what terms. Attitude scores and permit/warrant/favor marks live in the Faction Standing dimension.
